title: AccountRole
description: Conceptually frozen account roles. Not a universal one-strategy-one-account rule.

EXCLUSIVE_STRATEGY_MASTER.notes: One strategy owns one execution account (TB master, Rekey master, P90 master). Isolation, simple reconciliation, copier-master use. TB may remain an exclusive master.

PORTFOLIO_MASTER.notes: Multiple explicitly approved strategies share one account under ONE capital routing policy. Requires one authoritative shared heat ledger (no independent per-worker H1 state).

FOLLOWER.notes: Receives trades from an external copier. Observability only; Larger Lab does not directly manage follower replication in the first generation.

MIRROR.notes: Alias for a follower-type account used only for observability.
